summary: Flex Ltd. filed an 8-K disclosing an update on its planned spin-off of its cloud and power infrastructure business into a new independent publicly traded company. The filing announces key leadership roles for both entities, effective upon completion, which remains subject to Board approval and customary conditions. No financial terms, pricing, or exact timing were provided. The spin-off is intended to be tax-free for U.S. federal income tax purposes. The update signals progress but does not change the deal's structure. Watch for further filings detailing Board approval, shareholder mechanics, and expected spin-off date, which will clarify the arbitrage opportunity.
